description: Add and remove kernel and initrd images to and from the boot partition.

next.name: add
tip: Add a kernel and initrds to the boot partition.

next.name: add-all
tip: Add all installed kernels to the boot partition.

next.name: inspect
tip: Show what would be installed without changing anything.

next.name: list
tip: List installed kernel versions.

next.name: remove
tip: Remove a kernel and its initrds from the boot partition.

option.name: --boot-path
tip: Path to the $BOOT partition.

option.name: --entry-token
tip: Entry token to use for this installation.
Possible values: machine-id, os-id, os-image-id, auto
Use literal:TEXT for an arbitrary token.

option.name: --esp-path
tip: Path to the EFI System Partition.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --image
tip: Operate on a disk image as the filesystem root.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify the disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --json
tip: Generate JSON output.
Possible values: pretty, short, off

option.name: --make-entry-directory
tip: Create the $BOOT/ENTRY-TOKEN/ directory.
Possible values: yes, no, auto

option.name: --no-legend
tip: Do not show the headers and footers.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe inspect output into a pager.

option.name: --root
tip: Operate on an alternate filesystem root.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Increase verbosity.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.
